clue.text: African capital where an old banger may end up, do we hear?

indicators.note: the question asks whether the phrase is what we hear, so the answer is something said aloud

parts.words: where an old banger may end up
parts.note: an old banger is a clapped-out car, so its resting place is a car tomb, a scrapyard

explanation.surface: A wry question about where a worn-out car finishes its days.
explanation.walkthrough: A banger is British slang for an old, rickety car; 'car tomb' said aloud gives the Sudanese capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Khartoum is the capital city of Sudan, a nation in Africa.

clue.text: Dance a woman's beginning to accompany outside a bar

indicators.note: one part sits outside, around the other, in this clue

parts.note: something belonging to a woman is hers, so the possessive gives her
to bar is to ban

indicators.note: the beginning of a word is its first letter, taken here from accompany

explanation.surface: Instructions for a partner dance in which a woman joins someone near a pub counter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' puts HERA around A BAN, splitting it after the H.
explanation.definitionFit: The habanera is a Cuban dance in slow duple time, famous from Bizet's Carmen.

clue.text: Verbally control attempt to catch right type of woodpecker

indicators.note: said by mouth, so a word is to be heard rather than spelt

parts.note: to rein in is to control, as with a horse

indicators.note: catching something means holding it within, so one piece goes inside another

parts.note: a bid is an attempt

explanation.surface: Advice to check someone's attempt at seizing a right, by speaking up.
explanation.definitionFit: Rainbird is a dialect name for the green woodpecker, whose call was thought to foretell rain.

clue.text: Girl in party upset old poet

indicators.note: one piece is placed in the other here
in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the word reads backwards

parts.note: a do is a party
Vi is a girl's name, short for Violet

explanation.surface: A girl at a party is distressed by some aged versifier.
explanation.definitionFit: Ovid was a Roman poet of the Augustan age, author of the Metamorphoses.

clue.text: Restrain fellow fighter pilot capturing head of Luftwaffe?

parts.note: a fellow is a man

indicators.note: capturing something means enclosing it, so one piece goes inside another

parts.note: an ace is a fighter pilot with many kills

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A wartime scene: an airman takes the German air force chief prisoner.
explanation.definitionFit: To manacle is to put someone in handcuffs or shackles, so to restrain them.

clue.text: Extremely low bite from wild animal

indicators.note: wild suggests disorder, so the letters are scrambled
the extremes of a word are its first and last letters, here of low

explanation.surface: A savage beast gives a bite from very low down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Extremely' takes LW from 'low'; 'wild' rearranges LW, BITE and FROM.
explanation.definitionFit: The timber wolf is the grey wolf of North America, a wild carnivorous animal.

clue.text: Soak one's hair at first — it's fairly excessive

parts.note: to steep is to soak
one is I, and one's is I'S

indicators.note: at first means the opening letter of hair

explanation.surface: A remark that soaking one's hair is somewhat overdone.
explanation.definitionFit: Steep can mean excessive, as of a price, and the -ish ending makes it 'rather' so.

clue.text: Deal tiro organised for worshipper of false god

indicators.note: organised means put into a new order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A beginner arranges a deal on behalf of an idol-worshipper.
explanation.definitionFit: An idolater is one who venerates idols, images treated as gods, rather than the true God.

clue.text: Lively friend dipping into a new set of papers?

indicators.note: dipping into something means going inside it

parts.note: ID means identity documents, a set of papers
a mate is a friend

explanation.surface: An energetic pal leafs through a fresh bundle of documents.
explanation.definitionFit: Animated means full of life and spirit, as in an animated conversation.

clue.text: Old boy mostly existing with love in limbo

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil

indicators.note: one piece is placed in the other here
mostly means all but the last letter of the word

parts.note: existing means living
love is zero in tennis, written O

explanation.surface: A former pupil lives on with love while stuck in uncertainty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts LIVING to LIVIN, and 'in' places O within it.
explanation.definitionFit: Limbo is a state of neglect or being forgotten, which is what oblivion means.

clue.text: A right pain, a lemur, primarily living in tree!

parts.note: a bore is a pain, a tiresome person or thing

indicators.note: primarily means the first letter of lemur

explanation.surface: An exasperated complaint about a lemur that lives up a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Arboreal describes animals that inhabit trees, like many lemurs and monkeys.

clue.text: Plain nurse's distorted description of Iberia

indicators.note: distorted means twisted out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the word nurse, with 's standing for 'is' before the indicator

explanation.surface: A plain-speaking nurse gives a misleading account of Spain and Portugal.
explanation.definitionFit: Spain and Portugal occupy the Iberian Peninsula, so Iberia is peninsular in shape.

clue.text: Restaurant's pronounced gamble over hotel on river

indicators.note: in a down clue over means placed above the next piece
in a down clue on means sitting on top of the following piece
pronounced means spoken, so the word is heard not seen

parts.note: to stake is to gamble
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
the Ouse is a river in England

explanation.surface: A wager on a riverside hotel, apparently pronounced by a restaurant.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ouse is a river in England (there are several of that name).
explanation.definitionFit: A steakhouse is a restaurant specialising in grilled beef steaks.

clue.text: Sound made by chosen Caledonian tribesman

indicators.note: a sound made by a word is how it is said aloud

parts.note: picked means chosen

explanation.surface: A noise produced by a selected Scottish clansman.
explanation.definitionFit: The Picts were a people of ancient Caledonia, the Roman name for northern Scotland.

clue.text: Tack supplier's son finally fell, bitten by snake

parts.note: S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

indicators.note: something bitten by another is held in its jaws, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: the adder is Britain's only venomous snake

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of fell

explanation.surface: A horse-equipment dealer's boy falls after a snakebite.
explanation.walkthrough: Tack is horse gear such as saddles and bridles.
explanation.definitionFit: A saddler makes or sells saddles and other harness gear for riding horses.

clue.text: Southern queen with capacity to grasp bishop's argument

indicators.note: grasping something means holding it, so one piece goes inside another

parts.note: able means having capacity to do something
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A queen from the south has the power to take hold of a bishop's case.
explanation.definitionFit: A squabble is a petty, noisy quarrel, a kind of argument.

clue.text: Rise for poor peasant ringing about aquatic bird

indicators.note: ringing means encircling, so a piece goes inside
in a down clue rising means read from bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: bad means poor in quality
a hick is a country bumpkin, a peasant
C is short for circa, about

explanation.surface: A struggling farm worker's lot improves as they surround themselves with waterfowl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rise' reads the word for poor upwards, as this is a down clue; 'ringing' has the result plus the peasant around the abbreviation for about.
explanation.definitionFit: The dabchick is the little grebe, a small diving water bird.

clue.text: Token of victory originally that hurt reigning monarch

indicators.note: originally points to the first letter of victory

parts.note: ouch is the cry for 'that hurt'
ER, Elizabeth Regina, was the reigning monarch when the puzzle appeared

explanation.surface: A sign of triumph that wounded the sovereign.
explanation.definitionFit: A voucher is a token exchangeable for goods or services, like a gift token.

clue.text: Recce ship's officer's gun enclosure

parts.note: to case a place is to reconnoitre it, as a burglar does
a mate is a ship's officer; the 's stands for 'is' before the definition

explanation.surface: A naval scout's gun turret belongs to a ship's officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A casemate is an armoured chamber in a fortification or warship from which guns are fired.

clue.text: Developing army corps set up information outlet at last

indicators.note: in a down clue set up means raised, read upwards

parts.note: REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British Army corps
gen is British slang for information

indicators.note: at last means the final letter of outlet

explanation.surface: A military unit establishes a news point at the very end.
explanation.definitionFit: Emergent means coming into being or newly arising, so developing.

clue.text: Wax lyrical in this way entering quarters

indicators.note: entering means going inside the other piece

parts.note: ENE, east-north-east, is a point between quarters of the compass
thus means in this way

explanation.surface: Someone gushes as they come into their lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: To wax lyrical is to speak with eager enthusiasm, the idiom for enthusing.

clue.text: Boss missing start of Disney film

indicators.note: missing the start means its first letter is dropped

parts.note: Dumbo is a 1941 Disney film about a flying elephant

explanation.surface: The head of a studio is absent from the opening of a Disney picture.
explanation.definitionFit: An umbo is the central knob on a shield, the boss.

clue.text: Bird top man and woman located in tree

parts.note: a king is the top man of a realm

indicators.note: located in means placed inside

parts.note: a fir is a tree
she is a pronoun for a woman

explanation.surface: A monarch and a woman are found perched in a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The kingfisher is a brightly coloured bird that dives for fish.

clue.text: Exist as male insect, or biblical monster?

parts.note: to be is to exist
he refers to a male
a moth is an insect

explanation.surface: A choice between living as a male moth or as a giant beast of scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: Behemoth is the huge beast in the Book of Job, now any enormous thing.

clue.text: French priest born in Lincoln?

indicators.note: one piece is placed in the other here

parts.note: Abe was the familiar name of Abraham Lincoln

explanation.surface: A clergyman from France turns out to have been born in an English cathedral city.
explanation.definitionFit: Abbé is the French title for a priest or abbot.

clue.text: A French cookery writer reportedly never surpassed

parts.note: un is French for a

indicators.note: reportedly means as spoken, so the word is heard

parts.note: Mrs Beeton was a famous Victorian cookery writer

explanation.surface: A French culinary author is said to remain unrivalled.
explanation.walkthrough: Isabella Beeton wrote the Victorian 'Book of Household Management', a British kitchen classic.
explanation.definitionFit: Unbeaten describes a record or person never bettered, so never surpassed.

clue.text: Sanctions optical aids, including insurance cover to begin with

indicators.note: including means holding inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: lenses are optical aids

indicators.note: to begin with points to the first letters of insurance and cover

explanation.surface: Authorises spectacles, with insurance covering them at the start.
explanation.definitionFit: To sanction is to authorise or permit, which is what licensing does.

clue.text: The Spanish character long ago carrying priest's ordinal?

parts.note: el is the Spanish for the

indicators.note: carrying means holding inside, so one piece goes within

parts.note: eth is an Old English letter, a character long ago
Ven, Venerable, is the title of an archdeacon

explanation.surface: A Spanish letter of old bears a priest's numbered rank.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the definition by example: eleventh is one ordinal number.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordinal numbers state position in a sequence, and eleventh is one such number.
